text: anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito . esāhaṃ bho kaccāna taṃ #1 yu. āmeṇḍitaṃ . 2 yu. itisadudo natthi . bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ kaccāno dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgataṃ . yathā ca bhavaṃ kaccāno makkarakaṭe upāsakakulāni upasaṅkamati evamevaṃ lohiccakulaṃ upasaṅkamatu . tattha ye māṇavakā māṇavikā vā bhavantaṃ kaccānaṃ abhivādessanti paccupaṭṭhissanti āharissanti āsanaṃ vā udakaṃ vā dassanti tesantaṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti . navamaṃ . [210] ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā udāyi kāmaṇḍāyaṃ viharati
